eval-bot: Nightly eval finished for rwl-3b @ 2026-11-12 04:12 UTC — long-context fail rate increased from 2% -> 18% for the 'handoff_long' prompt set. Report: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1850123456

Maria L: saw the report. lots of truncation in the middle of instructions, e.g. prompt id h-4721: model cuts off right after 'Steps:' and the rest of instructions are gone.

Alex G: could be KV slot wrap or the stitching windowing change we merged last week. recalling we moved from 256 to 128 kv_slots_per_shard in the quant packer PR.

Jin W: can you paste a failing generation (the input + output) so I can check offsets?

Maria L: here's a minimal repro snippet — input shortened for slack:
```
INPUT:
"System: You are a translator. Translate the following paragraph to French. Steps: 1) read carefully 2) preserve names 3) don't translate code blocks"

OUTPUT (truncated):
"...Steps: 1) lire attentivement 2) préserver les noms 3)")
```
The expected output should include the rest of step 3 but it's missing. This happens when total prefix + prompt size crosses 16384 tokens.

Chris S: I ran a quick local run with --seq-len 65536 and replicated failure around 16384 boundary. Stack shows kv_index jumping from 16383 -> 0.

Alex G: that jump points to an off-by-one in the KV modulo math or a mismatch between runtime kv_slots and packer metadata.

Jin W: I'll run binary search across prefix lengths and collect KV-index traces. Command I'll use:
`python tools/run_eval.py --model rwl-3b --input samples/longctx/handoff.json --max-tokens 65536 --debug-kv --dump-kv-trace=out/kvtrace.handoff`

Maria L: also try running with the previous runtime build (tag 1.19.2) to see if the regression is in latest runtime vs packer.

Alex G: I already diffed the packer change: we changed header alignment for quantized blocks. If runtime expects old alignment it will compute kv_slot count differently. filing a quick note on the PR.

Chris S: I'll add a small assertion in kv_map to fail fast if seq_num > kv_slots * max_wrappers, to avoid silent wrap.

Maria L: assign owners: Jin you run the binary search and upload traces, Alex follow up on packer header alignment, Chris add the assertion + small unit test. I'll coordinate a rollback on nightly if we see more than 10% failures.

Jin W: on it, ETA 2h. :thumbsup:

Alex G: will open a draft revert PR if packer diff causes mismatch. :eyes:

eval-bot: incident-alert: nightly regression spike > 10% — paging eng-ml. https://ci.internal/redwood/incidents/1850123456

Maria L: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread and drop trace links here.
